maintainer: Member 2 - Legal Research & Verified Support Database
disclaimer: Numbers were taken from official websites on the date shown and have NOT yet been call-tested unless call_tested is true. Show the verified_on date to users. Numbers under unverified_phones are NEVER shown to users - they are waiting for a call-test.
recheck: All displayed contacts were re-checked against their cited sources on 2026-10-17 by an independent pass; exceptions are explained in each contact's notes.

levels.A: Contact details appear on the organisation's own official website (or the government department that runs the service), checked on verified_on.
levels.B: Contact details appear on an official government listing or official document, but the organisation's own site was not checked.
levels.C: Secondary sources only. display must be false.

contacts.name: Sindh Legal Advisory Call Center (SLACC) - Legal Aid Society
also_known_as: Sindh Legal Aid Society (SLAS) - name used on the Sindh Law Department website
contacts.services: Free legal advice by phone (Government of Sindh - Legal Aid Society partnership). The Legal Aid Society also offers free legal representation in court for people who cannot afford it, walk-in paralegal support and mediation.
contacts.how_to_access: Call 0800-70806 at any time.

sources.publisher: Law, Parliamentary Affairs & Criminal Prosecution Department, Government of Sindh (homepage: 'Toll-Free Legal Aid Helpline 0800-70806')
Legal Aid Society
Human Rights Department, Government of Sindh (helpline list)

verification.notes: sindhlegalaid.gov.pk (linked from the Law Department site) blocks automated access and was not opened. An old 2014 LAS page said calls from mobiles were charged at reduced rates - confirm current charging when call-testing.

Human Rights Department, Government of Sindh (online complaint system: Register / Login)

contacts.how_to_access: Call 1094 or use the online complaint form; or visit the women complaint cell at the district headquarters.

contacts.name: Tenant Registration - Karachi / Sindh Police (TRUST portal)
contacts.address: Concerned police station or police facilitation centre
contacts.services: Registration of tenants under the Sindh Information of Temporary Residents Act, 2015; a certificate is issued.
contacts.how_to_access: Visit the police station or facilitation centre with: original and copy of the owner's CNIC and the tenant's CNIC, the rent agreement, an affidavit and the tenant's photograph (about 15-20 minutes) - or register online on TRUST.

sources.publisher: Karachi Police (Sindh Police)

verification.notes: The official page links the TRUST portal with http; the portal ('Tenant Registration System': register with a mobile number and SMS code) also loads over https, checked 2026-10-17.

contacts.name: Pakistan Bar Council - Free Legal Aid (Central Free Legal Aid Committee)
contacts.services: Free legal aid for people who cannot afford a lawyer, under the Pakistan Bar Council Free Legal Aid Rules, 1999.
contacts.how_to_access: Fill the online application form on the Pakistan Bar Council website (applicant declares they are unable to afford legal costs and uploads case documents).

sources.publisher: Pakistan Bar Council (statutory body)

verification.notes: Mechanism, not a helpline.
